description: Ģeofizika (seismiskie profili) is a dataset listed in Latvian Geospatial Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo-dpps.viss.gov.lv. Total depth point method for the period from 1976. – 1994 Seismic profiles are in digital.sgy and analogue format in magnetic tapes depicting seismic research information obtained using the common depth point method in the territory of Latvia's land and Baltic Sea exclusive economic zone. Coverage: LV. The portal shows the English title as "Geophysics (seismic profiles)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2020-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geolatvija.
